metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Nell Gatechange
records.biography_en: Nell Gatechange booked a place with The Gate Has Moved. The gate moved again. The incident report lists wheeled carry-on with big blank tag, held entirely within cell as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The gate moved again.

records.name: Hank Bagscale
records.biography_en: Hank Bagscale booked a place with The Gate Has Moved. The scale is holding a grudge. The incident report lists stuffed suitcase cinched with a strap and portable bag scale as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The scale is holding a grudge.

records.name: Pip Traytable
records.biography_en: Pip Traytable booked a place with The Gate Has Moved. I think that's my shoe. The incident report lists small tray with belt and one single loose shoe as props as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I think that's my shoe.

records.name: Jade Dutyfree
records.biography_en: Jade Dutyfree booked a place with The Gate Has Moved. It's travel size if you squint. The incident report lists one small shiny shopping bag with absurdly huge perfume bottle peeking out as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: It's travel size if you squint.
